context.transcript:
Kenta, I was just in the frozen food aisle stocking the freezers and noticed several burned-out light bulbs.
In fact, there are a lot of burned-out light bulbs throughout the whole store.
I saw that, but we don't have enough bulbs to replace them all right away.
The fruits and vegetables section is really dark.
Let's have the maintenance staff replace those light bulbs now.
Well, it's right in the middle of the store, so that will brighten other areas too.
Good idea.
I'll ask Mr. Franklin for maintenance to meet us there now.
context.transcript_translation:
Kenta，我刚才在冷冻食品区整理冰柜时，注意到有几个灯泡烧坏了。
事实上，整个商店到处都有很多烧坏的灯泡。
我看到了，但我们现在没有足够的灯泡来全部更换。
水果和蔬菜区非常暗。
让维护人员现在去更换这些灯泡吧。
嗯，它就在店中央，这样也能照亮其他区域。
好主意。
我会叫 Franklin 先生安排维护人员现在到那里与我们汇合。
